Farm product order (dialogue-defined)

Back to quest database

Quick answer

A current-build clothing-store dialogue asks for three Large Chicken Eggs and one Giant Cow Milk, consuming each handoff.

Recorded build reference · 0.8.10.842 · configuration record, not individually play-tested

Objectives and actionable steps

  1. Hand over 3 Chicken Egg - Large; the dialogue checks the amount and removes 3.
  2. Hand over 1 Cow Milk - Giant; the dialogue checks the amount and removes 1.

Checks that can cause a stop

  • This lead is defined in dialogue, not the static quest table; runtime availability and its starting trigger remain unknown.
  • The reward branch configures 100,000 C when asking for money and 200,000 C after declining; neither branch is runtime-tested.
